description_en: Updates the name and configurations of the specified watermark template
description_zh: 更新指定水印模板的名称、配置
name: UpdateWaterMarkTemplate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the watermark template that you want to update. To obtain the ID of the watermark template, you can log on to the ApsaraVideo Media Processing (MPS) console and choose Global Settings > Watermark Templates in the left-side navigation pane
parameters.help_zh: 需要更新的水印模板ID，可以通过MPS控制台>全局设置>水印模板获取
parameters.name: water_mark_template_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the watermark template. The value can contain letters and digits and can be up to 128 bytes in size
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的模板名称。支持中英文、数字等，最大长度128字节。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The updated configuration of the watermark template. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.help_zh: 更新后的水印模板配置。JSON对象，更多信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
parameters.name: config

v1_parameters.help_en: The updated configuration of the watermark template. The value is a JSON object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29253.html
